author_note: User architecture instantiated: one trained model (Qwen2.5-0.5B compiled embeddings) = MEMORY; PBCS genius thinking patterns = RAM-resident compiled weights; at each reasoning-token prediction the system PULLS memory (kNN neighbor chains) and FUSES it with its own genius patterns (transition matrix + skeleton classifier) to predict the next token, then verifies against memory. v1's measured limits are attacked directly: (a) 33% grammar ceiling -> expanded operands + relaxed word-constant table with a train-side acceptance gate; (b) verify bottleneck (89.7% consensus fire, 2.6% precision) -> diversity-weighted consensus with distinct-signature support + source-confidence vote weights + per-skeleton magnitude bands.

mechanism_mapping_to_user_architecture.model_memory: frozen embedding library of 1000 solved problems (+ their mined reasoning chains, + answers), resident in RAM as fp64 arrays; pull = cosine kNN
mechanism_mapping_to_user_architecture.genius_pattern_weights_ram: compiled closed-form components listed under genius_ram_weights; zero gradients
mechanism_mapping_to_user_architecture.token_prediction_loop: iterative beam over reasoning-chain prefixes; each step scores candidate next-ops by fused(memory_pull, genius_pattern); completed chains are grounded and executed in parallel (no autoregression over surface text)
mechanism_mapping_to_user_architecture.verify_then_answer: verify stage vs memory bands + diversity-weighted self-consistency; consensus-only strict answer

data.train: gsm8k train subset frozen in scripts/realbench/prereg.json (indices, n=1000); embeddings emb_gsm_train.npy
data.eval_hle: HLE full pool 2370; T2-full = gold parses as positive integer under the same frozen v1 rule -> 572 rows (items_hle_full.json + emb_hle_full.npy)

mining_rules.genius_traces: identical to v1: calculator annotations <<expr=res>> from the 1000 solved problems; single-op-per-annotation chains of length 1..4; v1 measured 561/1000 clean
mining_rules.chain_used_for: memory pull source + transition matrix + seed distribution + per-skeleton magnitude bands

genius_ram_weights.1_skeleton_classifier: identical recipe to v1 amendment v1.2: closed-form fp64 ridge one-hot over top-24 ordered skeleton classes, lambda grid on train-val top-3 exact-class accuracy, plus kNN-5 skeleton recall; candidate multisets = union of classifier top-3 + kNN-5 neighbor chains, capped at 8
genius_ram_weights.2_word_constant_table_v2: relaxed vs v1 (v1: n>=3 AND n/tot>=0.4 -> 32 words): keep word->constant if n>=2 AND n/tot>=0.25; inject up to TOP8 constants (by support) whose word occurs in the question (v1: top4); text numbers capped at 12 (v1: 8)
genius_ram_weights.3_op_transition_matrix: P(next_op | prev_op) and P(first_op) mined from the 561 chains (Laplace-smoothed, alpha=1) - the compiled 'how geniuses continue a chain' weight
genius_ram_weights.4_skeleton_magnitude_bands: for each top-24 skeleton class: [q10, q90] of train golds bearing it; fallback = kNN-5 answer band [min/10, max*10] (v1 rule)

token_loop_rules.beam: breadth B=16 prefixes per depth, depth 1..4 ops, prefixes must stay compatible with at least one candidate multiset (op counts bounded, completion = counts exactly match a candidate multiset)
token_loop_rules.fusion_score: score(op at position t | prefix) = 0.5*mem + 0.5*genius (weights frozen 50/50, no test tuning)
token_loop_rules.mem_pull: over kNN-10 neighbors (cosine on raw normalized embeddings): weighted fraction of neighbors whose chain has op o at position t (neighbors without chains contribute zero mass); if no neighbor reaches position t, mem pull is zero-mass and genius dominates that step
token_loop_rules.genius_pull: product of (transition P(o|prev) or seed P(o)) and classifier_compat = fraction of classifier softmax mass on top-24 classes whose op counts can still absorb prefix+o
token_loop_rules.grounding_per_chain: v1 grounding search restricted to the chain's ordered ops: operands = 12 text numbers + up to 8 injected constants; intermediates single-use; cap 64 groundings per chain; total cap 1024 drafts/item; text-number-first ranking (v1 key)
token_loop_rules.dedup: prefix dedup by op tuple; draft dedup by (chain, sorted operand instances used)

verify_rules_v2.magnitude_band: per-chain-skeleton [q10,q90] if skeleton in bands, else kNN-5 band [min/10, max*10]; out-of-band drafts demoted below in-band ones (v1 rule, per-skeleton upgrade)
verify_rules_v2.vote_weight: source confidence: classifier softmax prob of the class that seeded the chain, or neighbor cosine for kNN-seeded chains; multiplied by 1.0
verify_rules_v2.consensus: support of a value = number of DISTINCT (chain, operand-signature) pairs reaching it; consensus requires distinct-signature support >= 2 (replaces v1's raw count>=2 which fired at 89.7% with 2.6% precision); tie by total weight, then first rank
verify_rules_v2.strict: consensus value else WRONG (abstain counts as wrong)
verify_rules_v2.loose: no consensus -> highest-weight valid draft (diagnostic only)

grammar_expansion_gate_train_side_only.metric: gold-skeleton operand coverage with cap 256 groundings (v1 measured 0.330 under v1 grammar)
grammar_expansion_gate_train_side_only.acceptance: expansion accepted iff v2-grammar coverage >= 0.43 (v1 0.330 + 0.10); if gate fails, eval proceeds with v2 grammar anyway but the gate result is reported honestly in build_times/diagnostics
grammar_expansion_gate_train_side_only.note: gate is measured on TRAIN rows with GOLD skeletons only; no test involvement

success_criteria_frozen.primary_gsm8k_full_strict: PASS if acc_strict >= 0.035 (approaching v1 loose 0.0402); PARTIAL if > 0.0235 (v1 strict); HONEST NEGATIVE if <= 0.0235
success_criteria_frozen.verify_fix_check: acc_when_consensus on GSM8K full must exceed v1's 0.02620 (else the diversity-consensus change is reported as a failed fix)
success_criteria_frozen.reporting_rule: whichever outcome occurs, real numbers are reported; no post-hoc criterion changes

run_integrity.wall_budget: foreground 460s slices, checkpoint/resume via state files, no background processes
